name: Wire New Capability
description: When a new skill or guardrail file is created, walks the wiring SOP and completes every missing attachment point so the capability actually loads and routes.

then.prompt: A new capability file was just created. A file on disk does nothing until it is wired in. 1) Follow sops/wire-new-capability.sop.md. 2) Run python3 context/scripts/validate-wiring.py --strict (use --skill NAME for one skill). 3) Complete every missing attachment point. 4) Re-run the validator and report. If it already passes clean, say so in one line and stop. Never silence a finding via allowlist unless the exemption is genuine and the reason is recorded in wiring.config.json.
